(1) Corridor: the trace leaves and rejoins the booked corridor at the identical coordinate (1.3465, 103.704), fixes 19 and 65; the outcome needs an exclusion of only >= 1.36 km to fail the 0.8 km test (>= 0.567 km to fail the 20 % test on the adjusted optimal, >= 0.68 km on the booked optimal), and even the straight-line J-stop-J reading (2 x 771.5 m = 1.543 km) fails both tests. (2) Uncited driver statement: POL-RD-04 is a test run on the record ('attributable to a rider instruction recorded in the chat_log'); if the 'no evidence id, no weight' rule were applied to raw party statements it would equally discard the rider's claim_text, which also cites no id, so the rider would fail the initial POL-RD-08 burden and the result would still be NO_ACTION. The 3.30 partial refund is reachable only by applying the rule to one side and not the other, which is not a careful reading. (3) Time: POL-RD-01 is a distance gate; with no deviation established, POL-RD-02 never runs and no clause licenses a time-only refund.
